source_policy: All 1027 unique root/child source files pin the immutable commit URL, Git blob SHA1, SHA256 and byte count. Raw archives stay in .tools. Public availability does not grant an open asset license.

field_policy.root_block: JSON Pointer /11; root header values retain original values without invented field names.
field_policy.instructions: Only Command/Event wrappers become instructions. Tagged enums are not interpreted as commands.
field_policy.time: Wait delays and hit-area lifetimes retain raw original units; no original frame rate has been verified.
field_policy.scope: Retain nested Block ownership and Wait context. Callbacks are not flattened into a simultaneous hit list.
field_policy.hit_area: Observed shape /9, lifetime policy /13, hit policy /14 (max-hit and minimum-interval variants are distinct). Parameter /23 is cross-checked as hit callback through its target-register use; /20 block and flags remain raw.
field_policy.damage: CreateNormalAttack parameter /6 is the observed multiplier range; other numeric and condition parameters remain raw.
field_policy.unknown: All original instruction payloads and JSON pointers remain present; an extracted opcode is not a supported runtime mechanic.

unresolved_semantics: Original clock units and absolute/relative Wait scheduling.
Target-mask and coordinate enum definitions; reference/follow flag semantics.
CreateHitArea parameter 15 Some value, exact per-target hit cadence and collision lifetime boundaries.
CreateNormalAttack parameter 8 combo flag, conditional bonus formula and remaining positional scalars.
DeleteCondition selector numeric arguments and complete engine selection/filter rules.
CreateBombMultiball physical movement, fuse/trigger and per-ball stat inheritance.
ACRegeneration healing formula and original engine stat-scaling order.
